chi-square-flow.alt: A worked chi-square test as a table and flowchart. Forty pill bugs in a two-sided chamber: observed 29 moist and 11 dry, expected 20 and 20. Each (o − e)² ÷ e is 4.05; χ² = 8.1. Degrees of freedom = 2 − 1 = 1; the critical value at p = 0.05 is 3.84. Since 8.1 is greater than 3.84, reject the null hypothesis.
